before: .standout-figure b { font-size:20px; font-weight:800; color:var(--standout-ink); }
after: .standout-figure b { font-size:20px; font-weight:700; color:var(--standout-ink); }

before: .standout-comp { display:flex; gap:4px; align-items:center; justify-content:flex-end; font-size:9px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:0.12em; }
after: .standout-comp { display:flex; gap:4px; align-items:center; justify-content:flex-end; font-size:9px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.12em; }

before: .standout-kicker { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; margin-bottom:9px; font-size:9.5px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:0.14em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--standout-dim); }
after: .standout-kicker { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; margin-bottom:9px; font-size:9.5px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.14em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--standout-dim); }
